tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Screen background. True black in dark themes so OLED pixels switch off.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Raised ground: routine cards, sheets, the keypad, grouped sections.

tokens.name: paper-3
tokens.usage: Control fills: editable number fields, secondary buttons, chips, keypad keys, the empty part of the rest bar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline separators between list rows and stat cells. Never a border around a card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on paper, paper-2 and paper-3. Fill of the primary button, with paper as its label. 11:1 or better on every ground in every theme.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: units, captions, last time, subtitles, inactive tab labels. 5.4:1 or better on paper, paper-2 and paper-3 in every theme.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Pending strokes, placeholder and ghost values, disabled text. A mark, not body text: 3:1 or better on paper and paper-2.

tokens.name: stroke-done
tokens.usage: A logged set's stroke. Follows ink unless a named theme gives sets their own colour.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one earned colour: personal records, beaten targets, upward deltas. Used as a fill behind on-signal text, or as a mark. Never for buttons, links or chrome.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and strokes drawn on a signal fill.

tokens.name: signal-edge
tokens.usage: Outline that keeps a signal mark visible on light paper (strokes, chart dots). Same as signal where signal already contrasts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions only (Discard workout, Delete). Text on paper and paper-2.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Web stand-in for the system Liquid Glass material on the tab bar and the Now Lifting accessory. Native builds use the system material.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, on every surface.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: t-number-xl
styles.usage: One hero number per screen: an exercise's estimated 1RM, the rest countdown. Always with ic-tnum.

styles.name: t-number-l
styles.usage: The set being logged, keypad display.

styles.name: t-number-m
styles.usage: Weight × reps in set rows, stat values.

styles.name: t-large-title
styles.usage: Tab roots only: Today, Plan, Progress.

styles.name: t-title-1
styles.usage: The object a screen is about: a routine, a workout, an exercise.

styles.name: t-title-2
styles.usage: Section headers on tab roots and detail pages. Title case is sentence case here: 'This week', not 'THIS WEEK'.

styles.name: t-title-3
styles.usage: Exercise names in the session, card titles.

styles.name: t-subhead
styles.usage: Secondary lines, coach notes, exercise lists on cards.

styles.name: t-footnote
styles.usage: Meta lines, chart labels, captions under numbers.

styles.name: t-caption
styles.usage: Units beside numbers, tab bar labels, axis ticks.

styles.name: t-eyebrow
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the date above Today, the label above a stat. Pair with ic-upper.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between strokes in a tally; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a row's text stack; chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a row's leading mark and its text; action bar vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards in a shelf.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen margin on iPhone and Android phones. Every left edge lines up on it.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap from a section header to its content's end; card padding on large cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a tab root.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap above the first section under a large title.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Grade marks, highlight swipes, chart tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Number fields, keypad keys, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Routine cards, the session card, sheets drawn by the app.

tokens.name: radius-capsule
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the Now Lifting accessory, the tab bar.

stroke.note: The tally: one stroke per set. Pending strokes are hairlines, logged strokes are stems, both centred in the same slot so nothing shifts when a set is logged.

tokens.name: stroke-h
tokens.usage: Stroke height in set rows and on cards.

tokens.name: stroke-h-hero
tokens.usage: Stroke height in the session header and the workout summary.

tokens.name: stroke-slot
tokens.usage: Width of a logged stroke and of the slot every stroke sits in.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Width of a pending stroke.

tokens.name: stroke-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between strokes.

tokens.name: stroke-group
tokens.usage: Gap after every fifth stroke, and between exercises.

control.note: Touch sizes. Nothing tappable is smaller than 44 × 44 points.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target in both directions.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: List rows and set rows.

tokens.name: button-h
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: accessory-h
tokens.usage: The Now Lifting accessory above the tab bar.
